narrative: Material PL1__M99E1076 exhibits erratic demand with a coefficient of variation of 1.52. The demand pattern shows 54% non-zero days with a mean daily demand of 156.7 units. Lead time is unstable with a mean of 1.25 days. The recommended safety stock of 503 units is 68% lower than the current SAP value of 1590 units. The optimal order quantity is 3528 units, constrained by the available storage capacity of 4031 units. This policy results in a review period of approximately 23 days and a reorder point of 699 units. The recommended policy is projected to save $1866.62 annually (67.6% reduction) compared to the current SAP policy, primarily through reduced ordering frequency (from 49 to 11 orders per year). Dominant uncertainty factor: demand variability accounts for 76% of total variance.
